text: Synth Patch Hero SYNTH PATCH HERO Gig board ⚙︎ Settings ← Gigs Rent's due. You have a modular synth and a phone that won't stop ringing. Your band broke up, your day job let you go, and all you kept was a dusty patch rack in your aunt's basement. Word got around that you can "make sounds." Now artists keep calling with oddly specific requests. Each gig comes with a reference sound. Patch modules together, twist the knobs, and match it by ear (and by graph). Every gig teaches you one new piece of synthesis. Hit a 90% match to get paid, then come back and do it cheaper. Every gig is open: start with Basics, or jump to whatever sounds fun.
